claim.text: The brake log is complete, so the timing analysis is not inconclusive for missing brake data.
The hazard onset reason was closing.
Perception took 0.1561 s, below the 0.3 s threshold.
Command took 0.0402 s, below the 0.1 s threshold.
Brake actuation took 1.32 s, above the 0.45 s threshold.
Full brake pressure was reached at 8.3619 s, after the 8.0 s impact.
A counterfactual using nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s, and nominal tau 0.35 s produced no contact.
The nominal counterfactual left a minimum gap of 0.3027 m.
Both the original witness and the independent recheck reported the other vehicle's brake lights were on.

args.question: Did the other vehicle have its brake lights on?
